title: Act: Emit playAnimation interact from the App action handler
summary: Add handleAction in App and pass it to ObjectOverlay
description: Create handleAction that calls game.act then emits playAnimation for the boy.
acceptance_criteria: Given handleAction, when called, then game.act runs and playAnimation interact is emitted
Given ObjectOverlay, when rendered, then onAction is handleAction

steps.action: Change the events import to also import reactToPhaser.
steps.code: import { phaserToReact } from './phaser/events'; -> import { phaserToReact, reactToPhaser } from './phaser/events';

steps.action: Add const handleAction = (objectId: string, actionId: string) => { game.act(objectId, actionId); reactToPhaser.emit('playAnimation', { target: 'boy', name: 'interact' }); }; placed before the return of the playing view (after the !begun early return).
steps.code: const handleAction = (objectId: string, actionId: string) => { game.act(objectId, actionId); reactToPhaser.emit('playAnimation', { target: 'boy', name: 'interact' }); };
